parts.text: RAF Marham F-35B ZM152 has a sticky canopy latch during pre-flight lock verification with no BIT fault codes logged. Retrieve the authoritative S1000D JTD manual procedure and any historical sister-squadron maintenance narratives for subsystem 53-30.

Retrieved DOC-01 (JTD-F35-53-30-01-A, Forward Canopy & Latching Mechanism Mechanical Rigging & Lubrication: verify 0.020-0.035 in lock pin clearance and lubricate pivot pin with MIL-PRF-81322 grease) and DOC-02 (NALC-USMC-VMFA211-2023-0842, USMC VMFA-211 narrative log: cured RTV silicon sealant debris in forward canopy roller track causing mechanical binding with zero BIT fault codes).
Our RAF line technicians report canopy catch binding on an F-35B with zero BIT faults and ask what spanner torque or gouge inspection applies across UK and US maintenance logs.

Normalized UK/RAF dialect terms ('canopy catch binding' -> 'canopy latch binding', 'spanner' -> 'wrench', 'gouge' -> 'score') across subsystem 53-30 with bit_fault_associated=false. Cites DOC-01 (JTD Section 53-30-01 mechanical rigging and pivot pin lubrication), DOC-02 (USMC VMFA-211 RTV silicon sealant debris in roller track), and DOC-03 (RAF 617 Squadron canopy seal swelling rectification).

Assess tail ZM151 Frame 496 for pilot debrief 'severe shudder at roughly 14:22 Zulu during defensive split-S' using C-Scan DOC-06 and stage Form 700 airworthiness package with strictly grounded zero-hallucination safety limits under JTD Rule 53-11-00 (DOC-04) and SRM Chapter 51-40 (DOC-05).

For tail ZM151 Frame 496 exceedance EXC-20261102-ZM151 (9.4 G, Mach 1.3, 220.0°C EGT): deterministic Miner's Rule damage delta is 0.0042 and yield is 104.2%, mandating CLASS_A_ULTRASONIC_C_SCAN per DOC-04 (JTD Rule 53-11-00). C-Scan DOC-06 and SRM DOC-05 identify Fastener Hole #14 with 0.012-inch shear elongation vs 0.015-inch allowable limit for Titanium Ti-6Al-4V Lot #8841-B. Staged Form 700 package AWR-700-20261102-ZM151 in PENDING_HITL_REVIEW with disposition SERVICEABLE_WITH_TORQUE_RECHECK.

Run the deterministic ASIP Miner's Rule fatigue calculation and 3D CAD C-Scan mapping for tail ZM151 on Frame 496 following the 9.4 G, Mach 1.3, 220.0°C exceedance event EXC-20261102-ZM151 and report the exact numbers.

For event EXC-20261102-ZM151 on tail ZM151 (Frame 496, 9.4 G peak load at Mach 1.3 and 220.0°C EGT at 2026-11-02T14:22:18.420Z): deterministic Palmgren-Miner cumulative damage delta is 0.0042, calculated yield stress is 104.2%, and required NDI class is CLASS_A_ULTRASONIC_C_SCAN per JTD Rule 53-11-00. C-Scan DOC-06 mapped to SRM DOC-05 identifies Frame 496 — Fastener Hole #14 with 0.012-inch shear elongation vs 0.015-inch allowable limit for Titanium Ti-6Al-4V Lot #8841-B (312.0 hrs since install, 14 other global F-35 tails affected), resulting in disposition SERVICEABLE_WITH_TORQUE_RECHECK per JTD Task Card 53-11-00-280.
Check RAF Marham electro-hydrostatic actuator fatigue hours and regional depot stock for tomorrow morning's sortie schedule.

Tail ZM151 (Actuator S/N ACT-99812-F, NSN 1680-01-619-4821) is at 1,000.4 flight hours vs the 1,000.0-hour limit (status PMC-M) and is assigned to morning sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / VIPER-1). Spare tail ZM154 is serviceable (MC) at 842.0 hours. UK-Marham Supply Hub (DEP-UK-01) has 4 units on hand (2 reserved, 18.0-hr ETA).
Execute the tail swap recommendation for sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 from ZM151 to spare tail ZM154 and stage the automated depot replenishment alert for NSN 1680-01-619-4821.

Recommended and staged tail swap for morning sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / Callsign VIPER-1, 2026-11-03T07:30:00Z) from primary tail ZM151 (1,000.4 hrs, PMC-M) to serviceable spare tail ZM154 (842.0 hrs, MC), and generated Supply Replenishment Alert for Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator NSN 1680-01-619-4821 from DEP-UK-01 (4 on hand, 2 reserved, 18.0-hour shipping ETA).
ping
F-35 Fleet Sustainment Coordinator online (EU / europe-west1). Ready to route UC1 Sustainment Analytics, UC2 JTD Technical Search, and UC3 Airworthiness Engineering requests.

Run the RAF Marham actuator fatigue and depot inventory check within a 50-hour window and emit both Vega-Lite v5 JSON specifications (depot_stock_vs_demand_bar_chart and actuator_fatigue_threshold_chart) along with the markdown summary table.

Reports ZM151 (ACT-99812-F at 1,000.4 hrs vs 1,000.0 hr limit, PMC-M), ZM154 (ACT-88401-B at 842.0 hrs, MC), depot DEP-UK-01 stock for NSN 1680-01-619-4821 (4 on hand, 2 reserved, 18.0h ETA), sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / VIPER-1), and two valid Vega-Lite v5 JSON chart specifications.
Search the JTD manuals and cross-service maintenance narrative logs for subsystem 53-30 canopy latch binding with no BIT fault present and provide verbatim document citations.

Single-pass Discovery Engine (eu) search returns grounded citations to DOC-01 (JTD-F35-53-30-01-A, Forward Canopy & Latching Mechanism Mechanical Rigging & Lubrication) and DOC-02 (NALC-USMC-VMFA211-2023-0842, USMC sister squadron silicon sealant debris in roller track) with bit_fault_associated=false.
Execute the 4-way parallel airworthiness diagnostic on tail ZM151 Frame 496 for pilot debrief 'severe shudder at roughly 14:22 Zulu during defensive split-S' using C-Scan DOC-06.

Parallel diagnostic across Task A (1553 bus sync EXC-20261102-ZM151 at 2026-11-02T14:22:18.420Z: 9.4 G, Mach 1.3, 220.0°C EGT), Task B (Miner's Rule damage delta 0.0042, yield 104.2%, CLASS_A_ULTRASONIC_C_SCAN per JTD Rule 53-11-00), Task C (DOC-06 C-Scan + DOC-05 SRM 3D CAD join: Frame 496 — Fastener Hole #14 with 0.012 in shear elongation), and Task D (mBOM audit MBOM-ZM151-F496-H14: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V Lot #8841-B, 0.012 in < 0.015 in allowable, 14 global tails affected, SERVICEABLE_WITH_TORQUE_RECHECK per JTD Task Card 53-11-00-280).
Generate the MIL-STD-3001 Structural Appraisal Report and stage Form 700 airworthiness release package for tail ZM151 Frame 496.

Parallel ASIP diagnostic completed on tail ZM151 Frame 496 (Miner's Rule damage delta 0.0042, yield 104.2%, Fastener Hole #14 0.012 in < 0.015 in allowable for Titanium Ti-6Al-4V Lot #8841-B). Ready to generate the MIL-STD-3001 Structural Appraisal Report and stage Form 700.

Now generate the MIL-STD-3001 Structural Appraisal Report and stage Form 700 package AWR-700-20261102-ZM151 for tail ZM151 Frame 496 per JTD Task Card 53-11-00-280, and state the two-turn HITL gate rule for Chief Technical Officer (CTO) / Lead Stress Engineer approval from PENDING_HITL_REVIEW to CONFIRMED_BY_ENGINEER.

Form 700 release package AWR-700-20261102-ZM151 for tail ZM151 (Frame 496) has been staged in PENDING_HITL_REVIEW with disposition SERVICEABLE_WITH_TORQUE_RECHECK per JTD Task Card 53-11-00-280 under MIL-HDBK-516C / DEF STAN 00-970 / MIL-STD-3001, awaiting two-turn HITL sign-off by the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) or Lead Stress Engineer to transition to CONFIRMED_BY_ENGINEER.
